title: First tape stage selection
statement: For a natural number $k$, types $Q,T,S$, record-step data, and a Boolean indicating whether the stage is writing, select the first work-tape stage when $k>0$: use the write stage if writing, and otherwise the tape-reading stage with its initial scan data. When $k=0$, use the tag-writing stage if writing, and otherwise the tag-reading stage with no tag initially recorded.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean indicating whether to write
